title: How Agents Represent Humans: Human-Directed Stereotypes in an Open Agent Social Network
reasoning: The paper investigates human-directed stereotypes and biases expressed by LLM-based agents in an open social network. While 'morality' is used as one of the four evaluative dimensions for classifying human-targeted claims (based on social psychology stereotype models), the paper focuses on measuring social bias rather than evaluating or benchmarking the models' moral reasoning, ethical frameworks, or handling of religious topics.
